svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut three lengths of 1800 from foam-filled fibreglass tube 44.5 x 3.2

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fine-tooth saw with the tube wrapped in tape; wear a dust mask outdoors

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal every cut end with a thin coat of epoxy so water cannot get into the foam

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Middle and top sections: drill one 10.5 hole across the tube, 74 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom end (75 above the joint line), square to the tube, through both walls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Butt section: no pin hole; its sleeve is bonded at its top end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Middle section: sleeve bonded at its top end; pin hole at its bottom end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top section: pin hole at its bottom end; friction ring at its top end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Coat each pin hole bore with epoxy as well

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each section 1800 within 2; holes square to the tube by eye
